coverage_decision: All main-text figures and tables and all seven supplied supplementary tables were inspected and reconciled. The long Supplementary Table 1 code list was not reproduced cell-by-cell; it is represented as reproducibility infrastructure and retained in the source packet.

omissions.reason: References are provenance infrastructure; citation entries themselves are not evidence atoms.

source_consistency_flags: Abstract primary composite HR 0.75 has 95% CI 0.65–0.87; Table 2 reports 0.65–0.86.
Abstract all-cause mortality HR is 0.76; Table 2 reports 0.75 with the same 95% CI 0.62–0.92.
Abstract MI/stroke/death composite HR 0.81 has 95% CI 0.70–0.95; Table 2 reports 0.70–0.94.
Abstract CKD-subgroup primary composite HR is 0.68 (0.53–0.88); Table 3 reports 0.67 (0.52–0.86).
